Name: Ancient Seeds in Garden Pots Allowed
Author: Aimon111
Description:
[center][color=#fff2cc][size=3]For some reason  in vanilla game you cannot grow Ancient Crops in garden pots (well, it's fair enought it won't grow in a pot actually) and I just recently discovered it, lol. So I made this small tweak that will allow to plant them in pots.

[/size][/color][size=2]Meant to be used with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20785]Leah Gives You Clay Pot[/url]﻿ mod in the first place. Thanks to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/56660577]Bloodstrael[/url] for giving the idea![/size][/center][size=3]
[b]Installation:[/b]
[list]
[list]
[*]Install SMAPi, Content Patcher.
[*]Unzip "Ancient Seeds in Garden Pots Allowed" archive into Stardew\Mods folder.
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[*]Enjoy.
[/list][/list]
This mod is compatible with pretty much anything and is safe to install on already existing save files.

Mods used on screenshots: [/size][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4363][size=3]Terracotta Garden Pots[/size][/url]
